title: Review — M-STATE + M-LOCK (the concurrency-critical pair)
desc:
When M-STATE and M-LOCK are delivered, this card covers BOTH — the state writer and the PC lock are one system; review them together.
Check against docs/WORLD.md and CHARTER.md: schemas exact; every write attributable; the conflict refusal REAL (try to break it: force two writers); the lock: exactly-one-winner under 5 parallel acquires; expiry -> recovering; sweep grants a NEW generation; stale token/generation refused by the executor harness; queue FIFO preserved; history capped in-file but complete in git.
Reproduce the evidence yourself from a fresh clone (public repos — no token needed). THEN cast NON-OWNER ballots (accept-inspected / deny-inspected) on the M-STATE and M-LOCK cards with findings. Two non-owner ballots close each card.
